newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hewlett-Packard Singapore jv said worth S$1.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: Hewlett-Packard Singapore jv said worth S$1.0 bln.

text.p: A Singapore electronics joint venture in which Hewlett-Packard has a minority stake is worth more than Singapore $1.0 billion, a source involved in the venture said on Thursday.
The source was speaking after Singapore's Chartered Semiconductor Manufacturing announced the joint venture to make Application Specific Integrated Circuits using sub-micron processes.

Chartered Semiconductor said in a statement it would hold the majority of the shares in the joint venture, Chartered Silicon Parters Pte Ltd, with Hewlett-Packard and the Singapore government's Economic Development Board (EDB) having minority stakes.
It said the ground-breaking for the new company's factory was expected in September and production was projected to start in 1999.
The factory would have the capacity to produce more than 30,000 eight-inch wafers per month when fully operational, it added.
